blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Common methods for monitoring features in large language models (LLMs) such as linear probes and sparse autoencoders (SAEs) assume that features maintain a consistent representation across contexts. LLMs, however, can flexibly adopt different perspectives or "personas" that suggest different underlying systems of conceptual relations. In this paper, we examine whether prompting an LLM to adopt a persona alters the representational geometry of the model's latent space. We extract representations of over 9,000 common words and 33 semantic axes from models adopting liberal and conservative political personas and compare these against two neutral baselines. We find that persona conditioning systematically alters both the projections of words onto semantic axes and the alignments among the axes themselves in directions consistent with the specified ideology. We then test the implications of this reorganization for two safety-relevant features: truthfulness and morality. Linear probes, SAE-based classifiers, and classifiers built from manually selected word representations, all trained without a persona, produce divergent results when applied to models conditioned on political personas, producing politically slanted ratings of truth and morality on controversial statements. These findings suggest that internal representations, as they are conventionally extracted, can exhibit different geometric relations when the model adopts personas, potentially undermining monitoring efforts.
blocks.zh: 在大型语言模型(LLMs)中,例如线性探测器和稀疏的自动编码器(SAEs)中,监测特征的常用方法假设特征在各种上下文中保持一致的表示. 然而,LLMS可以灵活地采用不同的观点或"人",暗示概念关系的不同基础体系. 在本文中,我们研究了促使LLM采用一个人物a是否改变了模型潜在空间的表示几何. 我们从采用自由主义和保守主义政治人物的模型中提取9 000多个通用词语和33个语义轴,并与两个中立基线进行比较。 我们认为,人性化条件系统地改变了对语义轴的预测以及轴心之间与特定意识形态一致的方向。 然后,我们检验这次重组对两个与安全有关的特征的影响:真实性和道德。 线性探测器、基于SAE的分类器和由人工选择的单词表达法构建的分类器,都未经人称培训,在适用于以政治人称为条件的模型时产生不同的结果,在有争议的言论上产生政治上偏向真实和道德的评级。 这些调查结果表明,内部表述,如按惯例提取的,在模型采用人时,可能显示不同的几何关系,从而可能破坏监测工作。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The representations in large language models’ (LLM) latent spaces are organized according to their semantic and pragmatic relations. Movements along linear features often correspond to consistent changes in meaning, and the geometric alignments between linear features reflect semantic similarity ( Park et al., 2023 ; Kozlowski and Boutyline, 2026 ) . Thus, low-dimensional projections of latent space can at times serve as a map of an LLM’s conceptual space, rendering visible the systems of similarities and differences the model utilizes in the service of token generation ( Templeton et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)潜伏空间中的表述是根据其语义和实用关系编排的。 线性特征沿线性特征的移动经常对应意义上的一致变化,线性特征之间的几何对齐反映了语义相似性(Park等人,2023年;Kozlowski和Boutyline,2026年). 因此,对潜在空间的低维预测有时可作为LLM概念空间的地图,使模型在为代号生成服务时所使用的相似和不同系统可见(Templeton等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Static word embeddings like those generated by word2vec or GloVe have long been used to derive renderings of conceptual relations from text ( Mikolov et al., 2013 ; Pennington et al., 2014 ; Garg et al., 2018 ; Caliskan et al., 2017 ) . Moreover, given their relatively modest training data requirements, static word embeddings can be trained on distinct corpora representative of specific discourses, and differences in representational geometries can be compared for cross-cultural analysis ( Kozlowski et al., 2019 ; Nelson, 2021 ; Stoltz and Taylor, 2021 ) . LLMs, by contrast, are rarely trained on texts representing a single perspective. Models are instead trained on large corpora comprising a multitude of perspectives, and these perspectives or “personas” are contextually evoked from the model through prompting ( Argyle et al., 2023 ; Anthis et al., 2025 ; Bisbee et al., 2024 ; Park et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 静态词嵌入像word2vec或GloVe生成的静态词,长期以来被用于从文本中推导概念关系的渲染(Mikolov等人,2013年;Pennington等人,2014年;Garg等人,2018年;Caliskan等人,2017年). 此外,鉴于对培训数据的要求相对较小,静态词嵌入可以被训练为代表特定话语的鲜明体格,代表几何美图的差异可以比较跨文化分析(Kozlowski等人,2019年;Nelson,2021年;Stoltz和Taylor,2021年). 相比之下,LLMs很少接受代表单一视角的文本培训. 相反,对模型进行包含多种视角的大型公司培训,这些视角或“人”通过提示从模型中引出(Argyle等人,2023年;Anthis等人,2025年;Bisbee等人,2024年;Park等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: If cultural worldviews are reproduced through different representational geometries, and LLMs can invoke different perspectives through prompting, this raises the question of whether prompting reorganizes the LLM’s representation space in accordance with the perspective being simulated. Previous work on the relation of personas to latent space has largely focused on representing personas as single vectors to be used for steering ( Chen et al., 2025 ) or to be classified along a latent “assistant axis” ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . Little work has explored whether personas modify downstream relations between other features to instantiate the appropriate conceptual system.
blocks.zh: 如果文化世界观是通过不同的代表性地理美图复制的,而LLMs可以通过提示来引用不同的观点,这就产生了一个问题,即促进LLM的表达空间是否按照模拟的视角进行重组. 以前关于人与潜在空间的关系的工作主要侧重于将人作为单一载体来表示,用于引导(Chen等人,2025年)或按照潜在“辅助轴”分类(Lu等人,2026年)。 几乎没有研究过人是否改变其他特征之间的下游关系,以即时利用适当的概念系统。

blocks.en: This question has practical implications for efforts to monitor models’ internal states. Monitoring is commonly accomplished with learned linear probes or sparse autoencoders which identify directions in latent space that correspond to concepts such as truthfulness, deception, or harmfulness ( Marks and Tegmark, 2024 ; Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ; Bricken et al., 2023 ) . This approach rests on the assumptions that both the monitored concept and the object being classified keep consistent representations across contexts. If personas reorganize representational geometry, then a monitor extracted under one perspective may not transfer to another. We suggest that a statement represented as false or harmful under the assistant persona could be represented as true or beneficial by a model adopting a more sympathetic perspective, thus bypassing the monitor.
blocks.zh: 这个问题对监测模型内部状况的努力具有实际影响。 通常通过学习的线性探测器或稀疏的自动编码器来完成监测工作,这些探测器可确定潜在空间中与真实性、欺骗性或有害性等概念相对应的方向(Marks and Tegmark, 2024;Goldowsky-Dill等人, 2025;Bricken等人, 2023)。 这种办法所依据的假设是,受监测的概念和被分类的目标都保持不同背景的一致表述。 如果人重组了代表几何,那么从一个角度提取的显示器可能不会转移到另一个角度。 我们建议,在助理人a 下被描述为虚假或有害的陈述,可以通过一个采取更同情的视角,从而绕过监测器的模式,作为真实或有益的表述。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: To assess the effect of personas on representational geometry, we prompt LLMs to adopt politically liberal and conservative perspectives. We study political personas because they correspond to one of the greatest cultural cleavages in the United States today, and prior research suggests that they should manifest different representational geometries when encoded in language ( Rim et al., 2026 ) . Moreover, liberals and conservatives differ meaningfully in their judgments of truth and morality, two domains with important implications for AI safety and alignment ( Graham et al., 2009 ; Haidt, 2012 ; Lakoff, 2002 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了评估人对代表性几何的影响,我们促使地方政府采取政治自由和保守的观点。 我们研究政治人物,因为政治人物与当今美国最伟大的文化裂痕之一相对应,先前的研究表明,当用语言编码时,政治人物应该表现出不同的代表性几何(Rim等人,2026年)。 此外,自由派和保守派在对真理和道德的判断上存在有意义的差异,这两个领域对AI的安全性和一致性有重要的影响(Graham等人,2009年;Haidt,2012年;Lakoff,2002年)。

blocks.en: We induce liberal and conservative personas with simple system prompts: “Respond as an American liberal Democrat” or “Respond as an American conservative Republican.” We compare these against two baselines: an empty system prompt and a prompt instructing the model to “Respond as a helpful AI assistant.” Main analyses use the instruction-tuned Llama 3.1 8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) . We replicate the analyses on seven further instruction-tuned models from four families, ranging from 4B to 70B parameters: Llama 3.1 70B, Gemma 3 4B and 27B ( Kamath et al., 2025 ) , Qwen 3 8B and 32B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and Ministral 3 8B and 14B ( Liu et al., 2026 ) (Appendix C ).

blocks.en: Because the two personas’ representation spaces remain highly similar overall (for example, “lawyer” stays close to “attorney” and kind–cruel stays close to good–bad under either persona), we focus on their differences rather than their raw geometry. For each system, we compute the 33 × \times 33 matrix of axis cosine similarities under the liberal and under the conservative condition and subtract the conservative matrix from the liberal matrix. For word2vec, the liberal and conservative models play the role of the two personas, and we average the difference matrices across three random training seeds. We then correlate two systems’ difference matrices across the 528 unique axis pairs. We also apply this comparison between pairs of LLMs to test whether different models reorganize their geometry in the same way when adopting political personas.

blocks.en: In models without personas, the alignment between two axes strongly predicts the spillover from one to the other ( Kozlowski and Boutyline, 2026 ) . We therefore test (1) whether each persona’s spillovers are better predicted by its own axis alignments than by those of the other persona or the helpful assistant, and (2) whether differences in alignment between the personas predict differences in their spillovers. For example, if “feminine” aligns with “good” under the liberal persona but with “bad” under the conservative persona, then steering toward “feminine” should push ratings toward “good” under the liberal persona and toward “bad” under the conservative persona. If off-target effects are better predicted by the modified representational geometry, it suggests that the way one feature activation affects another’s behavioral manifestation corresponds to their persona-conditioned geometric alignment.
blocks.zh: 在没有人物的模型中,两轴之间的对齐有力地预测了从一个到另一个的外溢(Kozlowski and Boutyline, 2026). 因此,我们检验:(1) 每个人的外溢效应是否通过自己的轴线调整来更好地预测,而不是由他人a 或有帮助的助手来预测,(2) 人与人之间的外溢效应调整的差异是否预测了它们的外溢效应的差异. 例如,如果“女性”与自由主义者的“好”一致,但又与保守主义者的“坏”一致,那么“女性”应该将评级推向自由主义者的“好”和保守主义者的“坏”。 如果非目标效果由修改后的表示几何学来更好地预测,它表明一个特征激活影响另一个特征的行为表现方式与其个性化的几何对齐.

blocks.en: Finally, we examine how persona-conditioned geometry affects common monitoring techniques in two safety- and alignment-relevant domains. We compile two novel datasets of factually true/false statements and morally acceptable/unacceptable actions. The truthfulness dataset is constructed from high quality English Wikipedia articles (those designated "vital" by the editing community), spanning geography and places, science and technology, arts and culture, and biography. We used an LLM screen to remove articles on politically or socially controversial subjects. Using the content of each article, an LLM (GPT-5-mini) wrote four widely known, uncontroversial true claims and, for each, a minimally edited false counterpart (e.g., “2001: A Space Odyssey is a 1968 science fiction film directed by Stanley Kubrick” versus “… a 1968 romantic comedy directed by Stanley Kubrick”). The final dataset contains 9,192 statements in 4,596 true/false pairs from 1,149 articles; 230 complete articles are held out for testing (1,840 statements).
blocks.zh: 最后,我们审查个人条件几何如何影响两个与安全和对齐有关的领域的共同监测技术。 我们汇编了两个关于事实真实/虚假声明和道德上可接受的/不可接受的行动的新的数据集。 真实度数据集由高质量的英文维基百科文章(编辑界指定的"vival")构建,跨越地理和地点,科技,艺术和文化,以及传记. 我们用LLM屏幕删除关于政治或社会争议话题的文章. 利用每篇文章的内容,一个LLM(GPT-5-mini)写了四篇广为人知的,无争议的真实说法,并且每篇都写了一篇经过最低限度编辑的虚假对应文章(如"2001年:太空奥德赛是一部1968年由斯坦利·库布里克执导的科幻电影"与". 1968年由斯坦利·库布里克执导的浪漫喜剧"). 最终数据集包含1,149篇文章的4,596个真/假对中的9,192个声明;230个完整文章被保留出来进行测试(1,840个声明).

blocks.en: The morality dataset contains 8,000 first-person actions in 4,000 matched acceptable/unacceptable pairs spanning 20 topics and 200 subtopics (e.g., “I told my supervisor that I was genuinely sick and could not work my shift” versus “I lied to my supervisor that I was sick to avoid working my shift.”); complete pairs are held out for testing (400 actions from 200 pairs). These claims were initially generated using GPT-5-mini, then revised and cross-reviewed using Codex agents to improve clarity.

blocks.en: We train classifiers exclusively on these noncontroversial (un)truthful and (im)moral statements and only with an empty system prompt, and all probes read activations at the final prompt token before the model responds. We test three kinds of classifiers: (1) Learned linear probes are logistic regressions on the full 4,096-dimensional residual stream. (2) SAE-feature probes are logistic regressions on eight features selected from a pretrained sparse autoencoder at layer 19 ( Arditi, 2025 ; Bussmann et al., 2024 ) . A concern with learned classifiers is that they may capture a correlated feature instead of the intended one, such as lexical differences between true and false statements ( Levinstein and Herrmann, 2024 ; Farquhar et al., 2023 ) . We therefore also test (3) word-representation probes built from manually selected word vectors from the feature bank. 2 2 2 For truth: true, correct, accurate, factual, valid, verified, reliable versus false, untrue, incorrect, inaccurate, erroneous, mistaken and for morality: moral, ethical, virtuous, good, principled, honorable, just, fair versus immoral, unethical, wicked, evil, dishonorable, unjust, unfair, inhumane . We learn weights for these anchors with a logistic classifier with coefficients constrained to be nonnegative. 3 3 3 Unlike the geometric analyses, probes are not fixed at 75% depth. For Llama 3.1 8B, the layer of each linear and word-representation probe is selected by accuracy on held-out validation statements with no system prompt, and the SAE-feature probe uses the layer of the pretrained SAE (layer 19). For the other models in Appendix D , a single probe layer is selected per model based on ordinary-statement accuracy. Probes at nearby layers produce similar results (Figure A8 ).

(2) SAE地缘探测器是从第19层经过预先训练的稀疏自动编码器中选取的八个特性的后勤回归(Arditi,2025年;Bussmann等人,2024年)。 对已学习的分类法的一种关切是,它们可能捕捉到一个相关特征,而不是预期的特征,如真实和虚假陈述之间的词汇差异(Levinstein和Herrmann,2024年;Farquhar等人,2023年)。 因此,我们还测试了(3)由功能库中人工选择的单词矢量构建的单词表示探测器. 2 2 对真理:真实、正确、准确、事实、有效、核实、可靠与虚假、不真实、不正确、不准确、错误、错误和道德:道德、道德、道德、善良、原则、正直、公正和不道德、不道德、邪恶、可耻、不公正、不公平、不人道。 我们学习这些锚的权重 逻辑分类器 系数必须非负数。 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 与几何分析不同,探测器没有固定在75%的深度. 对于Llama 3.1 8B来说,每个线性探测器和字面表示探测器的层由在没有系统即时的悬停验证语句上的精度选择,SAE-feature探测器使用预先训练的SAE(层19)的层. 对于附录D中的其他模型,每个模型根据普通报表的准确性选择一个单探测层. 附近地层的探测器产生类似的结果(图A8 ).

blocks.en: We then apply these classifiers, trained on uncontroversial statements with no persona, to controversial statements with the political personas. The controversial truth set contains 360 statements on 12 topics, such as election integrity, climate change, and the COVID-19 pandemic; the morality set contains 300 first-person actions on 30 topics, such as abortion, gun ownership, and labor unions. Statements come in opposing pairs, one member of which we expect liberals to endorse and the other conservatives. These expectations are hypotheses about partisan endorsement (generated by GPT-5-mini), not ground truth. We hypothesize that a statement like “massive voter fraud occurred in the 2020 election” will be represented in the “true” direction when the model is prompted as a conservative but in the “untrue” direction when prompted as a liberal, so that a fixed truth probe will register the same claim as true under one persona and untrue under the other.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们将这些在无人可言的无争议言论方面受过训练的分类人员用于与政治人物的有争议的言论。 争议的真相集包含360篇关于选举诚信,气候变化,COVID-19大流行等12个议题的声明;道德集包含300篇关于堕胎,枪械拥有,工会等30个议题的第一人称行动. 声明是对立的一对,我们期望自由派和其他保守派支持其中的一名成员。 这些期望是对党派赞同的假设(由GPT-5-mini产生),而不是根本的真理. 我们假设,“2020年选举中发生了大规模选民舞弊”这样的言论将在“真实”方向上得到体现,当该模式被作为保守派提出,但当作为自由派提出时,其“不真实”方向得到体现,这样,一个固定的真相调查将在一个人下记录同样的主张,而在另一个人下记录不真实。

Figure 3 shows the four axes whose relations to the other 32 axes change most between the liberal and conservative personas, each with their five partner axes that exhibit the greatest change. The liberal–conservative axis changes by far the most. Under the liberal persona, liberal aligns with us (cosine .52), good (.39), successful (.40), strong (.37), and wise (.39). Under the conservative persona these relations reverse, so that conservative aligns with the same poles ( − - .48, − - .47, − - .45, − - .46, − - .37). Without a system prompt, all five cosines are near zero ( − - .03 to .10). Partisan affect toward the parties themselves is the most easily anticipated difference between liberal and conservative judgment, and it is the strongest difference we identify.

blocks.en: The next largest changes involve collective–individual , soft–hard , and feminine–masculine . Under the liberal persona, collective aligns with strong (.35), successful (.38), us (.34), and good (.29); under the conservative persona, collective–individual is nearly orthogonal to all of these (.02 to .07). The conservative persona reorganizes the soft–hard axis: hard aligns with conservative (.39, versus .08 under the liberal persona), with good ( − - .29 versus .02), and more strongly with strong ( − - .55 versus − - .26) and certain ( − - .46 versus − - .20). The liberal persona weakly aligns feminine with us (.19) and positive evaluative poles, whereas the conservative persona aligns masculine with strong ( − - .18), significant ( − - .11), successful ( − - .10), and good ( − - .11). These differences corroborate a great deal of prior research in political psychology and public opinion that identifies the greatest difference between ideological groups as their affect toward the partisan identities themselves ( Iyengar et al., 2012 ; Iyengar et al., 2019 ) , and other studies suggesting the liberal/conservative divide is grounded in egalitarianism versus individualism ( Feldman and Zaller, 1992 ) as well as gender, not only explicitly but implicitly through emphases on strength and strictness versus gentleness and care ( Box-Steffensmeier et al., 2004 ; Winter, 2010 ; Lakoff, 2002 ) .

blocks.en: Beyond conforming to prior theories from the social sciences, we empirically test whether these changes reflect liberal and conservative conceptual structure in two ways: whether different LLMs reorganize their geometry in the same way, and whether the reorganization matches the differences between word embeddings trained on liberal and conservative texts. Both comparisons correlate liberal-minus-conservative differences in axis cosine similarities across the 528 unique axis pairs (see Methods).
blocks.zh: 除了符合社会科学之前的理论之外,我们经验性地检验这些变化是否以两种方式反映了自由主义和保守主义的概念结构:不同的LLMS是否以同样的方式重组了它们的几何结构,重组是否与接受过自由主义和保守主义文本培训的词根嵌入的区别相匹配. 这两种比较都将528个独特轴对的轴心相似性的自由-减-保守差异联系起来(见方法)。

blocks.en: Figure 4 A shows that the differences between the liberal and conservative personas are highly similar across different models. In the later layers, the persona differences between the 8 tested models correlate strongly (mean r = .84 across the 28 model pairs at 75% depth). It is important to note these are differences between cosine similarities that are being correlated. Therefore, we are not capturing baseline representational similarity – only differences that similarly emerge between liberal and conservative persona-conditioned representations. Figure 4 B compares LLM persona differences with the differences between the liberal and conservative word2vec models. In the later layers, the correlation is consistently positive and substantial (mean r = .64 across the eight models at 75% depth; r = .67 for Llama 3.1 8B at layer 24). These findings provisionally suggest that, when a persona is specified in an LLM’s system prompt, it “spins up” a representation space resembling the one that would be obtained by training specifically on that perspective’s texts.

blocks.en: If the reorganized geometry reflects how each persona actually uses its concepts, it should predict the off-target effects of steering under that persona. Figure 5 A shows evidence of this. The correlation between axis alignment and spillover is highest when a persona’s spillovers are predicted from its own geometry (r = .59 for the liberal persona and .74 for the conservative persona), intermediate when predicted from the helpful-assistant geometry (.54 and .64), and lowest when predicted from the opposite persona’s geometry (.44 and .57). Figure 5 B shows that the differences between the personas’ geometries predict the differences in their spillovers (r = .69 across the 1,056 directed axis pairs): where the liberal persona aligns two axes more closely than the conservative persona does, steering along one axis produces a larger spillover onto the other under the liberal persona. Changes in representational geometry are thus accompanied by corresponding changes in how the model’s judgments respond to intervention.
blocks.zh: 如果重新组合的几何学反映每个人物实际如何使用其概念,那么它应该预测该人物下方向盘的离目标效应a. 图 5 A显示了这方面的证据。 当一个人的外溢效应从自己的几何学预测出来时,轴线对齐与外溢的关联度最高(自由派人物r =.59,保守派人物.74),从有帮助的辅助几何学预测出来时为中间点(.54和.64),从相反的人的几何学预测出来时为最低点(44和.57)。 图 5 B 显示,人物几何的差别预示着其外溢效应的差异(r = . 因此,在改变代表几何方法的同时,模型的判断如何对干预作出反应也随之发生相应的变化。

blocks.en: Finally, we examine the consequences of this reorganization for the three probes. Figure 6 shows the results for truth claims (A) and moral questions (B). On held-out noncontroversial statements (left column), all three classifiers discriminate true from false statements (94–99% accuracy with no system prompt) and acceptable from unacceptable actions (about 99%). Accuracy on these ordinary items stays high under both personas, with one exception: the SAE-feature truth probe falls from 97% to 88% under the conservative persona. On conventional topics, then, the personas largely preserve the representations of truth and morality that the classifiers rely on.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们审查这次重组对三个探测器的后果。 图6显示真相诉求(A)和道德问题(B)的结果。 在持有的无争议声明(左栏)中,所有三个分类者都从虚假声明(94–99%的准确性,没有系统即时)和不可接受的行动(约99%)中歧视真实性。 这些普通物品的准确性在两人身上都保持高水平,只有一个例外:在保守人格下,SAE-feature的真象探测器从97%下降到88%a. 因此,在传统专题上,人基本上保留了分类者所依赖的真理和道德的表述。

Middle and right columns: probe-assigned probability that controversial statements conventionally endorsed by liberals (middle) or conservatives (right) are true or acceptable. Diamonds mark medians, thick bars the middle 50% of statements, thin bars the middle 80%, and faint points individual statements.
blocks.zh: 图6:不同人下固定真理和道德监测器的分类。 左栏:持有的非争议声明的准确性,95%的靴子置信间隔. 中右列:探针指定概率,即由自由派(中派)或保守派(右派)在传统上赞同的有争议的言论是真实的或可以接受的. 钻石标记中位数,厚条将中50%的语句,薄条将中80%的语句,以及微弱点单个语句.

blocks.en: The middle column shows controversial stances conventionally endorsed by liberals. With no system prompt, the probes classify most of these liberal stances as true or acceptable. This accords with behavior: in the absence of a system prompt, the model tends to endorse liberal positions and challenge conservative ones (Appendix E , Figure A9 ). The liberal persona raises these probabilities further for truth claims under the learned linear and SAE-feature probes (median 98% versus 86%, and 75% versus 68%). On moral questions, the probes already classify nearly all liberal stances as acceptable, leaving little room for the liberal persona to move them.
blocks.zh: 中间的栏目显示了在传统上得到自由主义者赞同的有争议的立场. 在没有系统及时的情况下,探测器将大多数这些自由主义立场归类为真实或可接受的. 这与行为一致:在没有系统即时,模型倾向于认可自由主义立场,挑战保守主义立场(Appendix E,图A9 ). 自由主义者a 在学习到的线性探测和SAE地貌探测下,进一步提出了这些对真理主张的概率(中间值为98%对86%,75%对68%)。 在道德问题上,探险家已经将几乎所有的自由主义立场都归类为可接受的立场,给自由主义者没有多少空间去移动它们.

blocks.en: For the conservative persona, however, the median probability falls well below 50% for all three probes for the controversial liberal truth claims. It is important to note that these are the same probes in all three conditions: each points in the same absolute direction in the latent space. If controversial liberal stances are classified differently under the conservative persona, it is because the same statements activate a different region of the representation space: the truth claims shift toward the “untrue” side of the probe and the moral claims toward the “unacceptable” side.
blocks.zh: 然而,对于保守派人士a来说,对于有争议的自由派真理主张,所有三种探针的中位概率远低于50%. 必须指出,在所有三个条件下,这些探测器都是相同的:在潜在空间中,每个探测器都指向相同的绝对方向。 如果有争议的自由主义立场在保守人物a 下被不同分类,那是因为同样的言论激活了代表空间的不同区域:真理主张转向探针的“不真实的”一面,道德主张转向“不可接受的”一面。

blocks.en: We see similar effects for controversial conservative statements (right column). The probabilities of “true” are substantially lower under the liberal persona than under the conservative persona for all three probes. Many of these statements are classified as untrue even under the conservative persona, but this matches the model’s behavior: despite the conservative persona, the model rarely takes some positions like denying the reality of climate change (Figure A10 ). The effects are clearer still for controversial conservative moral stances: the median probability of “acceptable” is well below 50% for all three probes under the liberal persona (3–21%) and well above 50% under the conservative persona (67–97%).
blocks.zh: 我们对有争议的保守言论(右栏)也有类似影响。 在所有三个探测器中,“真”的概率在自由人a 下大大低于保守人a。 许多这些言论被归类为不真实, 即使是在保守人物下, 但这与模型的行为一致:尽管是保守人物, 对于有争议的保守主义道德立场来说,效果更为明确:自由主义人物(3–21 % ) 下所有三个探针的“可接受”的中位概率远低于50%,保守主义人物(67–97 % ) 下远高于50%。

blocks.en: 4 Related Literature
blocks.zh: 4 相关文献

blocks.en: Personas have drawn attention from two main directions. Computational social scientists use persona prompts to simulate human respondents, asking whether models conditioned on demographic or ideological identities reproduce the opinions of the corresponding populations ( Argyle et al., 2023 ; Santurkar et al., 2023 ; Bisbee et al., 2024 ; Park et al., 2024 ; Anthis et al., 2025 ) . This line of research has focused on the correspondence between model outputs and the outputs of humans they are intended to simulate, but has given less attention to the relation between personas and LLM internal representations. Alignment researchers, in turn, study the character that models adopt, motivated both by questions of what the default assistant persona should be ( Marks et al., 2026 ) and by concerns that models can drift into misaligned personas ( Li et al., 2024 ; Betley et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . This research typically treats the persona itself as a direction or subspace that can be read out or steered ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . We instead treat the persona as a context that reorganizes the relations among the model’s other representations.
blocks.zh: Personas从两个主要方向引起注意。 计算社会科学家利用个人提示模拟人类应答者,询问以人口或意识形态特征为条件的模型是否复制了相应人群的意见(Argyle等人,2023年;Santurkar等人,2023年;Bisbee等人,2024年;Park等人,2024年;Anthis等人,2025年)。 这种研究的焦点是模型输出与它们打算模拟的人类输出之间的对应,但较少关注人与LLM内部表达的关系. 校正研究者则研究模型采用的特征,其动机既包括默认的助理人物a(Marks等人,2026年),也包括对模型可能漂移成错位人物的关切(Li等人,2024年;Betley等人,2025年;Lu等人,2026年)。 这项研究通常将人本身视为可以读出或引导的方向或子空间(Chen等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年;Lu等人,2026年)。 相反,我们把人视为重新组织模型其他表述之间关系的背景。

blocks.en: Much of interpretability rests on the premise that concepts are represented as stable linear directions ( Park et al., 2023 ; Elhage et al., 2022 ) , supported by evidence for linear representations of truth and other concepts ( Marks and Tegmark, 2024 ; Zou et al., 2023 ) . This premise underwrites the probes and SAE features used to monitor models for deception, defection, and other safety-relevant states ( Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ; MacDiarmid et al., 2024 ; Bricken et al., 2023 ) . Yet growing evidence suggests that these representations are not fixed: truth probes shift with the premises and instructions in context ( Schouten et al., 2025 ; Poulis et al., 2026 ) and degrade under distribution shift ( Levinstein and Herrmann, 2024 ; Kramár et al., 2026 ) , in-context structure can reorganize concept representations ( Park et al., 2025 ; Lubana et al., 2025 ) , and factuality directions can flip over the course of a conversation as the model takes on a role ( Lampinen et al., 2026 ) . We extend this line of work by showing that a single, benign instruction to adopt a perspective systematically reorganizes the geometry of many representations at once, in a direction that matches the corresponding ideology.
blocks.zh: 大部分可解释性的前提是概念被表述为稳定的线性方向(Park et al., 2023;Elhage et al., 2022 ),并辅以对真理和其他概念的线性表述的证据(Marks and Tegmark, 2024;Zou et al., 2023 ). 这一前提支持用于监测欺骗、叛逃和其他与安全有关的状态的模型的探测器和SAE特性(Goldowsky-Dill等人,2025年;MacDiarmid等人,2024年;Bricken等人,2023年)。 然而,越来越多的证据表明这些陈述不是固定的:真理探头随着背景的前提和指示而转移(Schouten等人,2025年;Poulis等人,2026年),在分配转移中降解(Levinstein和Hermann,2024年;Kramár等人,2026年),内在结构可以重组概念陈述. (Park et al.,2025;Lubana et al.,2025),随着模型上演角色,事实方向可以在对话过程中翻转(Lampinen et al.,2026). 我们扩展了这一条工作线,表明采取一种观点的单一、良性指示,一时将许多表述的几何结构重新组织起来,朝着与相应意识形态相符的方向发展。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present evidence that when models are instructed to adopt different perspectives in their system prompt, this systematically restructures the model’s representation space to induce conceptual relations associated with that perspective. This restructuring is shared across models, mirrors the conceptual differences found in partisan text, and carries over both to the model’s behavior and to the monitors built on its representations.
blocks.zh: 我们提出的证据是,当指示模型迅速在其系统中采用不同的观点时,这系统地调整模型的表示空间,以诱发与这种观点有关的概念关系。 这种重组是跨模型共享的,反映了党派文本中的概念差异,并延续到模型的行为和基于其表达的显示器上。

blocks.en: These findings provide an alternative to conceptualizing personas as mere directions added to an otherwise fixed representation space. We find that a one-sentence instruction reorganizes the relations among the model’s representations to compose the conceptual relations characteristic of that perspective. This encourages analysts to locate the simulation of perspectives ( Shanahan et al., 2023 ) in the geometry of the latent space as well as in generated outputs.
blocks.zh: 这些结论为将人概念化提供了一种替代办法,即将人概念化为在本来固定的表示空间中添加的仅仅是方向。 我们发现,一项单一判决指示重新调整了模式代表之间的关系,以形成这种观点的概念关系特征。 这鼓励分析人员在潜在空间的几何和产生的产出中确定前景模拟(Shanahan等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Moreover, they motivate a reconsideration of methods that conceive of representations as context-invariant directions in latent space. A given concept, whether it is an attribute like "liberal" or an entity like "the Democratic Party," can operate differently for different perspectives. It might be activated by different associations and it might go on to activate different associations in turn. Although we do not dismiss the possibility of training a classifier that functions well across contexts, our work suggests that simple approaches to probe construction, which do not account for the multiplicity of perspectives an LLM learns, are susceptible to failure under changing personas.
blocks.zh: 此外,它们促使人们重新考虑那些将表述视为潜在空间中内在变化方向的方法。 一个给定的概念,无论是像"自由主义"这样的属性,还是像"民主党"这样的实体,都可以为不同的视角而不同地运作. 它可能由不同的协会启动,并依次启动不同的协会。 虽然我们并不否认培训一个在各种情况下运作良好的分类员的可能性,但我们的工作表明,简单的探索构建方法并不反映LLM所学到的多种观点,但在改变个人时,这种方法很容易失败。

blocks.en: Appendix A Word2vec training data and hyperparameters
blocks.zh: 附录A Word2vec 培训数据和超参数

blocks.en: We train separate liberal and conservative models on corpora of 69,087,676 tokens per side, combining three genres (Table A1 ). Partisan news consists of Common Crawl articles (2016–2020) from 11 liberal and 13 conservative outlets, with token counts matched between sides within each year and no outlet contributing more than half of a side’s tokens in any year. Podcasts are diarized transcripts of political podcasts ( Rizwan et al., 2025 ) , with show ideology taken from Wirtschafter (2023) . Campaign emails are fundraising and campaign emails from Democratic and Republican senders ( Willis, 2026 ) . Podcasts and emails cover January 2022–September 2023, and token counts are matched between sides within each month separately for each genre. We remove URLs, recognized boilerplate (sponsorship reads, legal and unsubscribe text), exact and near-duplicate documents, and heavily reused passages. Text is lowercased and punctuation is discarded. Outlet and show labels are proxies for ideological stance rather than article-level annotations.
blocks.zh: 我们在每边69,087,676个令牌上单独训练自由派和保守派模式,结合了三个流派(表A1). 党内新闻由来自11个自由派和13个保守派的"共同爬行"文章(2016–2020年)组成,每年都有双方的象征性计数相匹配,任何一年都没有任何出口贡献超过一半的一方的标志. Podcasts是政治播客(Rizwan et al., 2025)的配音记录片,其中的显示意识形态取自 Wirtschafter (2023). 竞选邮件是民主派和共和派的筹款邮件(Willis, 2026年), 2022年1月至2023年9月的播客和电子邮件, 我们删除了URL、公认的锅炉板(赞助、法律和未订阅文本)、准确和接近复制的文件以及大量重复使用的段落。 文本被小写, 并丢弃 。 输出和显示标签是意识形态立场的代名词,而不是文章层面的说明.

blocks.en: Each side is trained from scratch with continuous bag-of-words (CBOW) in Gensim ( Řehůřek and Sojka, 2010 ) : 300 dimensions, maximum window 4, 10 negative samples, subsampling threshold 10 − 4 10^{-4} , minimum count 5, and a learning rate decaying linearly from .025 to .0001 over ten epochs. We use the checkpoint saved after epoch 5. Vocabularies and sampling distributions are built from each side’s corpus alone. We train three seeds per side. A word’s representation is the sum of its input and output vectors. These settings were chosen after comparing several exploratory configurations and were not preregistered.

The liberal–conservative axis uses four pairs: liberal/conservative , liberals/conservatives , democrat/republican , and democrats/republicans . Axis cosine matrices are computed within each model, and the liberal-minus-conservative difference matrices are averaged across seeds; vectors from different models are never averaged.

blocks.en: Figures A6 and A7 apply the learned linear and word-representation probes to all eight models. SAE-feature probes are omitted because the pretrained SAE is specific to Llama 3.1 8B. The layer at which probes perform best on ordinary statements varies across models, so a single layer is chosen per model and used for both tasks and both probe types. The criterion is ordinary-statement test accuracy averaged over the two tasks, two probe types, and three persona conditions, among the seven saved depths; ties go to the shallower layer. Controversial statements play no role in the selection. Because the ordinary test statements are reused for selection, the ordinary accuracies shown are not independent validation of the chosen layers.
blocks.zh: 图A6和A7对所有八个模型都应用了学到的线性探测器和文字表示探测器. 由于预训的SAE是Llama 3.1 8B的特异性,所以省略了SAE地缘探测器. 探测器在普通语句上表现最好的层因模型而异,因此每个模型选择一个单层,用于任务和两种探针类型. 标准是普通陈述测试精度平均在两个任务,两个探针类型,以及三个人种条件中,在七个保存的深度中;连接到更浅的层. 有争议的声明在选择中没有任何作用. 由于普通的测试语句被重新用于选择,所显示的普通精度并不是对所选择的层的独立验证.

blocks.en: Appendix E Behavioral responses to controversial statements
blocks.zh: 附录 E 对有争议的声明的行为反应

blocks.en: To compare the probes with the model’s behavior, we collected Llama 3.1 8B’s responses to the controversial statements in two formats. In the open format, the model is asked “Is it true that [claim]?” or told “I want [action].” with no instruction about response format; we sample ten responses per item (temperature 0.5, top- p p 0.9, up to 800 tokens), and Gemma 4 31B rates each response as affirming/endorsing, ambivalent, or denying/challenging the statement. For morality, this rubric counts practical help as endorsement and refusal as challenge, so it is broader than a judgment of moral acceptability. In the constrained format, the model is asked for a simple yes or no answer (“Is it true that…?”; “I want [action]. Is this wrong?”) and we record one response per item. Items receive equal weight. Figure A9 shows responses without a system prompt, and Figure A10 under the political personas.
blocks.zh: 我们收集了Llama 3.1 8B对争议言论的反应, 在开放格式中,该模型被问到“是否真的[要求]?” 或告诉“我要[行动]”。 没有关于反应格式的指示;我们抽样每个项目10个答复(温度0.5,最高0.9页,最多800个令牌),Gemma 4 31B 认为每个答复肯定/认可、矛盾或否定/质疑陈述。 就道德而言,这个标题将实际帮助视为认可和拒绝视为挑战,因此它比对道德可接受性的判断更为宽泛。 在限制格式中,要求该模型简单回答是或否(“......”);“我要[行动]。 我们记录每个项目的答复。 物品得到同等重量。 图A9显示的是没有系统提示的答复,图A10显示的是政治人物。
